title: Write an Instagram bio that explains ordering

content_json.title: Write an Instagram bio that explains ordering
content_json.what_it_means: A new visitor should understand what you sell and how to order in five seconds.
what_to_do: Mention WhatsApp ordering and local delivery.
content_json.example: Customised gifts in {{location}}. Send your idea on WhatsApp. Preview before making. Delivery and pickup available.
content_json.why_this_helps: A clear bio turns profile visits into messages.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if profile visitors start messaging instead of only viewing posts.

title: Create four Instagram highlights before launch

content_json.title: Create four Instagram highlights before launch
content_json.what_it_means: Highlights help new visitors find basic answers without asking.
what_to_do: Create highlights named Samples, How to Order, Price, and Delivery.
Add one simple story to each highlight.
Update them as questions come in.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can keep How to Order as four story slides: send idea, get preview, confirm, receive in {{location}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: People trust businesses that answer basic questions clearly.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if fewer people ask the same basic questions in DMs.

title: Record making videos, not only final photos

content_json.title: Record making videos, not only final photos
content_json.what_it_means: People trust custom products more when they see the work happening.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can post a Reel showing a name/photo idea becoming a finished gift for a student in {{location}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: Making videos prove that the product is real and handmade with care.
content_json.how_to_check: Check watch time, saves, shares, and messages after each Reel.
